Best Free Movies on Pluto TV (August/September 2023)

Originally published 21 August 2023 · RewindZone Archive

Lists & RecommendationsStreaming guides

We're always on the lookout for great free streaming options to revisit some old favorites. With the rising costs of streaming services and movie tickets, free streaming platforms like Pluto TV have become an excellent option for cinephiles on a budget.

Pluto TV offers an extensive on-demand movie library with hundreds of classic, indie, and popular films spanning various genres - all available to stream for free. Their lineups refresh regularly, making it easy to find new free movies to watch every month.

We've explored Pluto TV's current offerings and rounded up some of the best free movies available to stream in August and September 2023. Whether you're a fan of comedy, drama, horror, or sci-fi, you're sure to find something to enjoy from decades past and present.

Thrillers

For those who love an adrenaline rush, Pluto TV has a slate of free thriller movies that will keep you on the edge of your seat:

Hours (2012)

Advertisement

This emotional thriller drama stars Paul Walker in one of his final roles. He plays a father desperately trying to keep his premature baby daughter alive in a New Orleans hospital that has lost power during Hurricane Katrina. The film earned critical praise for Walker's powerful performance.

High Crimes (2002)

In this military courtroom thriller, Ashley Judd plays a high-powered lawyer who ends up defending her husband (Morgan Freeman) against serious criminal charges from his past as a Marine. The twists and turns keep ramping up the suspense.

Dramas

From serious Oscar contenders to poignant coming-of-age stories, Pluto TV has an array of dramas streaming for free:

The Illusionist (2006)

Edward Norton and Paul Giamatti star in this turn-of-the-century drama about a gifted magician in 1900s Vienna who falls in love with a woman far above his social standing. The visual style and performances create a brooding, magical atmosphere.

Tracks (2013)

Advertisement

Mia Wasikowska stars in this adaptation of Robyn Davidson’s memoir about her solo trek across the Australian Outback in the late 1970s. The stunning landscape photography makes this thoughtful drama an immersive viewing experience.

Begin Again (2013)

This charming musical drama follows a washed-up record producer (Mark Ruffalo) who discovers and collaborates with a talented young songwriter (Keira Knightley) in New York City. The soundtrack features original songs performed by the cast.

Draft Day (2014)

Kevin Costner leads an all-star cast including Jennifer Garner and Denis Leary in this look behind the scenes on the hectic day of the NFL Draft. The high stakes wheeling and dealing makes for an engaging sports drama.

Cruel Intentions (1999)

This deliciously campy teen drama/romance puts a modern spin on the classic novel Les Liaisons dangereuses by bringing it to an elite Manhattan prep school. Sarah Michelle Gellar and Ryan Phillippe play manipulative step-siblings who make a dangerous bet.

Comedies

When you need a good laugh, Pluto TV has an entertaining selection of comedy classics available:

Empire Records (1995)

This coming-of-age comedy follows the wild antics of employees at a fictional record store over the course of one unforgettable day. With a youthful cast including Liv Tyler, it's a quintessential 90s nostalgia trip.

The Cobbler (2014)

Adam Sandler plays a lonely New York City shoe repairman who discovers a family heirloom that allows him to literally walk in other people's shoes. This whimsical comedy explores identity and empathy in clever ways.

Sci-Fi

For fans of thought-provoking futuristic stories, be sure to check out these free sci-fi options:

eXistenZ (1999)

This cult classic from director David Cronenberg stars Jennifer Jason Leigh as a designer of an immersive virtual reality game system who goes on the run with a security guard (Jude Law) after an assassination attempt. The lines between reality and fantasy blur in trademark Cronenberg style.

Horror

If you're up for some chills and thrills, Pluto TV delivers free horror movies like:

An American Werewolf in Paris (1997)

Two American tourists run into dangerous supernatural trouble while backpacking across Europe in this comedic horror film. Fans of cult classic An American Werewolf in London will enjoy the callbacks and special effects.

Pluto TV's selection of free movies offers something for every taste - from critically acclaimed dramas to nostalgic comedies and cult horror. Their frequently refreshed on-demand movie library makes it easy to find new classic films to rediscover or enjoy for the first time.

For thrifty cinephiles, Pluto TV is a treasure trove of free streaming entertainment. Be sure to bookmark their site to check back each month for new additions to their already impressive free movie catalog.

As a nostalgic movie blog, we'll continue scouring streaming platforms old and new to uncover the best retrospective films available to watch. Pluto TV has proven a go-to free destination for satisfying our classic movie cravings without breaking the bank.
